what: Create a specification from a data frame
title: Building, sorting and using specifications
text: df_to_yspec() writes yspec YAML file data frame describes variables. Entries code list may code=label label=code, separated commas new lines. Supply codelist_func parse another format.
code: variables <- data.frame(   name = c("WEIGHT", "SEX", "AGE", "ID"),   label = c("Body weight", "Sex", "Age", "Subject identifier"),   unit = c("kg", NA, "years", NA),   type = c("numeric", "character", "numeric", "numeric"),   codes = c(NA, "F=Female, M=Male", NA, NA) )  path <- tempfile(fileext = ".yaml") df_to_yspec(   variables,   desc = "Example data set",   varname = "name",   vardesc = "label",   varunit = "unit",   vartype = "type",   varcodelist = "codes",   output = path ) #> YAML file created: /tmp/RtmpiRk9g4/file1b22a5fe78f.yaml spec <- yspec::ys_load(path) names(spec) #> [1] "WEIGHT" "SEX"    "AGE"    "ID"

title: Building, sorting and using specifications
text: ys_sort_spec_vars() orders specification match columns data frame. Specification variables data follow, original order, data columns specification ignored.
code: data <- data.frame(ID = 1, AGE = 35, SEX = "F", WEIGHT = 65) sorted <- ys_sort_spec_vars(data, spec) names(sorted) #> [1] "ID"     "AGE"    "SEX"    "WEIGHT"

title: Building, sorting and using specifications
text: ys_write() writes loaded sorted specification back YAML. output standalone specification: lookup results written full, derived fields omitted, comments formatting kept.
code: out <- tempfile(fileext = ".yaml") ys_write(sorted, out) names(yspec::ys_load(out)) #> [1] "ID"     "AGE"    "SEX"    "WEIGHT"

title: Building, sorting and using specifications
text: ysx_load_pkpdspec() loads specification standard NONMEM columns ID, TIME, DV, CMT, EVID AMT. missing_code -999, DV allows missing values, ID group column.
code: pkpd <- ysx_load_pkpdspec() head(names(pkpd), 10) #>  [1] "C"    "NUM"  "ID"   "TIME" "TAFD" "TAD"  "SEQ"  "OCC"  "CMT"  "EVID" pkpd$EVID$decode #> [1] "observation"    "dose"           "other"          "reset"          #> [5] "reset and dose"

title: Building, sorting and using specifications
text: ysx_plt_relab() relabels axis legend titles facet_wrap() facet_grid() strips specification, units axis titles. Coded facet values decoded.  Use label_type = "long" "short" choose specification field. error raised field missing plotted variable. Use labs custom labels, facet_labels individual facet levels, var_map data name differs specification name.
code: library(ggplot2)  dose <- data.frame(   TIME = c(0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2),   DV = c(0, 4, 3, 0, 5, 4),   EVID = c(0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1) ) p <- ggplot(dose, aes(TIME, DV)) +   geom_line() +   facet_wrap(~EVID)  ysx_plt_relab(p, pkpd) renamed <- setNames(dose, c("time", "conc", "evid")) p2 <- ggplot(renamed, aes(time, conc)) +   geom_line() +   facet_wrap(~evid)  ysx_plt_relab(   p2,   pkpd,   var_map = c(time = "TIME", conc = "DV", evid = "EVID"),   label_type = "long",   facet_labels = list(evid = c(`0` = "Observation", `1` = "Dose")) )

title: Checking data against a specification
text: ysx_check() returns TRUE invisibly everything passes. check fails prints every problem stops. Use error_on_fail = FALSE get FALSE back instead. runs check, ysx_check() asserts data specification match: every column data must variable specification, every specification variable must column data. default error_on_fail = TRUE mismatch raises error. FALSE reported problems, error_on_fail also forwarded individual checks. ysx_check_missing() less strict: requires data columns specification.
code: ysx_check(data, spec) #> The data set passed all checks. bad <- data bad$CMT[2] <- -999 ysx_check(bad, spec, error_on_fail = FALSE) #> The data set passed all checks. #> Additional check messages: #>   - CMT: 1 missing value(s) found but na_ok is not true (default)

title: Checking data against a specification
text: ysx_check_missing() runs missing-value check returns problems character vector. Every column data must described specification, otherwise raises error (returns problem error_on_fail = FALSE). specification may describe columns data . Missing values allowed default. Allow column dots: {na_ok: true} YAML. specification missing_code, plain NA problem even na_ok true. second specification can merged checking spec2. Columns exist keep definition spec.
code: ysx_check_missing(bad, spec) #> [1] "CMT: 1 missing value(s) found but na_ok is not true (default)" ysx_check_missing(   data[c("ID", "DV")],   yspec::ys_select(spec, ID),   spec2 = yspec::ys_select(spec, DV) ) #> character(0)

title: Checking data against a specification
text: ysx_check_repeats() counts rows group stops group exactly count rows (default 1). equivalent grouping, counting, checking count differs count. Missing values count group value. Pass grouping columns groups avoid editing specification. columns must exist specification. error_on_fail = FALSE problems returned instead:
code: ids <- data.frame(ID = c(1, 1, 2), TIME = c(0, 0, 0)) ysx_check_repeats(ids, spec, groups = c("ID", "TIME")) #> Error: #> ! 1 of 2 group(s) defined by ID, TIME do not have 1 row(s) (row counts found: 2) ysx_check_repeats(ids, spec, groups = c("ID", "TIME"), error_on_fail = FALSE)

title: Checking data against a specification
text: ysx_regroup() removes existing group settings marks new ones. ysx_ungroup() removes . return new specification. Within ysx_check(), required number rows per group comes pre_grp_count dots group columns: group columns set must agree.
code: regrouped <- ysx_regroup(spec, c("ID", "TIME")) names(Filter(function(x) isTRUE(x$dots$group), regrouped)) #> [1] "ID"   "TIME"  ungrouped <- ysx_ungroup(spec) names(Filter(function(x) isTRUE(x$dots$group), ungrouped)) #> character(0)

title: Factor ordering with ysx_factors
text: Set order first keep level order defined specification, biggest sort levels decreasing frequency data converted. Omitting order equivalent first. values accepted. following example creates loads specification. project, pass path existing YAML file yspec::ys_load() instead.
code: SETUP__:   description: Example factor ordering RESPONSE:   values: {Low: 1, Medium: 2, High: 3, Unused: 4}   dots: {order: first} library(yspecx)  spec_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".yaml") yaml::write_yaml(   list(     SETUP__ = list(description = "Example factor ordering"),     RESPONSE = list(       values = list(Low = 1, Medium = 2, High = 3, Unused = 4),       dots = list(order = "first")     )   ),   spec_path ) spec <- yspec::ys_load(spec_path) unlink(spec_path)  data <- data.frame(ID = seq_len(7), RESPONSE = c(3, 2, 2, 3, 2, 1, NA))

title: Factor ordering with ysx_factors
text: first refers specification order, order first appearance data. High appears first data, Low first factor level.
code: first <- ysx_factors(data, spec) levels(first$RESPONSE) #> [1] "Low"    "Medium" "High"   "Unused" head(first) #>   ID RESPONSE RESPONSE_v #> 1  1     High          3 #> 2  2   Medium          2 #> 3  3   Medium          2 #> 4  4     High          3 #> 5  5   Medium          2 #> 6  6      Low          1

title: Factor ordering with ysx_factors
text: Change setting YAML file, update loaded specification: Medium occurs three times, High twice Low . unused level remains last. Missing observations contribute counts unless explicit factor level. underlying observations sorted changed; level order changes. Frequencies calculated data supplied call. levels equal counts, relative order follows original yspec factor order. Although High appears first, Medium precedes equal counts Medium comes first specification. Unused levels also keep relative specification order.
code: spec$RESPONSE$dots$order <- "biggest" biggest <- ysx_factors(data, spec) levels(biggest$RESPONSE) #> [1] "Medium" "High"   "Low"    "Unused" table(biggest$RESPONSE, useNA = "ifany") #>  #> Medium   High    Low Unused   <NA>  #>      3      2      1      0      1 tied <- ysx_factors(data.frame(RESPONSE = c(3, 2)), spec) levels(tied$RESPONSE) #> [1] "Medium" "High"   "Low"    "Unused"

what: Select columns and retain original values
title: Factor ordering with ysx_factors
text: Column selection value-column options follow yspec::ys_factors(). Pass unquoted column names restrict conversion. Use .keep_values = FALSE omit original codes, .suffix choose column suffix.
code: selected <- ysx_factors(data, spec, RESPONSE, .keep_values = FALSE) names(selected) #> [1] "ID"       "RESPONSE"  with_codes <- ysx_factors(data, spec, RESPONSE, .suffix = "_code") head(with_codes) #>   ID RESPONSE RESPONSE_code #> 1  1     High             3 #> 2  2   Medium             2 #> 3  3   Medium             2 #> 4  4     High             3 #> 5  5   Medium             2 #> 6  6      Low             1

title: Factor ordering with ysx_factors
text: Existing factor columns left unchanged, including level order. change ordering previous conversion, call ysx_factors() original coded data rather factor output. invalid dots$order setting raises error variable converted. Settings unselected variables existing factors validated.
code: unchanged <- ysx_factors(first, spec) identical(levels(unchanged$RESPONSE), levels(first$RESPONSE)) #> [1] TRUE

title: yspecx 0.1.0
text: (feat) df_to_yspec(): Convert data frame yspec specification file (fix) df_to_yspec(): Stop duplicate variable names instead silently keeping last row, accept .yml output paths. (feat) ysx_check(): Also runs ysx_check_repeats(), forwarding error_on_fail. Groups must unique default; set dots: {pre_grp_count: <n>} group columns require n rows, pre_grp_count: ~ (null) skip check. Data columns specification variables must match directions: mismatch raises error, reported error_on_fail = FALSE. (feat) ysx_check_missing(): New exported missing-value check. Missing values now disallowed default; allow per column dots: {na_ok: true} (replaces anymissing). Every data column must specification (error unless error_on_fail = FALSE), optionally merging second specification (spec2). specification may describe columns data . (feat) ysx_check_repeats(): Raise error group defined specification’s group: true columns exactly count rows (default 1), unless error_on_fail = FALSE, case problems returned. Use groups define groups call, like group_by() counting rows checking none n != count. (feat) ysx_load_pkpdspec(): Load bundled pkpdspec.yaml specification standard NONMEM columns (ID, TIME, DV, CMT, EVID, AMT, …). (feat) ysx_ungroup(): Remove group settings specification, column defines groups. (feat) ysx_regroup(): Remove existing group settings specification mark new group columns. (feat) ysx_plt_relab(): Relabel plot axes, legend titles facet strips yspec, custom variable facet-level labels, plot--spec variable mappings, validated long/short label selection. (feat) ys_sort_spec_vars(): Order loaded specification match data frame columns preserving metadata unmatched specification variables. (fix) ys_write(): Accept .yml output paths. Preserve coded-value labels write reloadable metadata saving loaded sorted specifications. (feat) ysx_factors(): Extend yspec factor conversion per-variable dots$order settings first (default) biggest (decreasing frequency), retaining unused levels specification order ties. Warns values specification become NA.
